title: Obsidian Daily Note Gap Over Three Days
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obsidian:note note_type=daily
| stats max(_time) as last_note by vault
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_note)/86400,1)
| where days_since>3
| sort - days_since
description: Uses Obsidian daily-note events telemetry to monitor how long each vault has gone without a daily note in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for journaling gaps that break personal tracking continuity, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Obsidian daily-note events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Vault table of days since last daily note.
grandmaExplanation: It lists how long each vault has gone without a daily note so you can spot journaling gaps that break personal tracking continuity before it becomes annoying.
